implementation.summary: D33 fixes the authenticated control-plane FinOps serializer: slotted dataclass records were previously emitted as empty objects because the route only inspected __dict__. The serializer now walks dataclass fields, preserves Decimal values as exact strings, and recursively encodes labels, enums and time values. A real local-composed HTTP journey covers usage, costs, budgets, alert evaluation, acknowledgement, CLI visibility and restart persistence.
